ratings_why.fun: The save-then-drain turn is a real spike to play for, but most growth is flat +1/+1 packets and the early Carnival thresholds sit idle until turn 4 or 5.
ratings_why.distinct: Holding gold as a paid resource is new for this genre's shops, and two rival counters on one tribe make every last gold a choice; the Spent half alone would feel like a familiar spend-gold tribe.

verdict_why: Nothing is broken or unreadable; what's left is hot late numbers for the owner to balance, and more passes would mostly shuffle thresholds.

points.text: Turns 1-4 have almost no Carnival play: Root Nymph's Fanfare 6 and Bandstand Horn's Fanfare 7 can't fire before income reaches them. A Tier 1 Carnival tempo body, or Fanfare 4 on the Nymph, would give the spend side an opening.

Once 16 gold is banked, Old Messor and Mother Melissa pay every turn for nothing more. Paying for how many turns the float has been held, and resetting it on a drain turn, would make the crossing a real trade.
Signora Afide wants 8 Spent and 8 held in the mid game, about 16 gold; at Tier 4 that is rare. Fanfare 6 / Reserve 6 would let her fire both halves when she is bought.
Fights are mostly stat piles. The listed swap for Winter Cluster (a hurt front-row unit trades places with the one behind it) would give the Hive a fight moment beside Gravelle.
Ottavia is the best crossing card; showing 'Spent 10 / Purse 10' next to her on screen would make the balance target easy to aim at.

standouts.why: Madame Cigale turns a saved float into one huge board-wide turn: the fable as a payoff you plan for.
Tithonus doubles Fanfares only at double the number, so the multiplier asks for more spending instead of free value.
Wax Sealer is a Hive card that moves gold from Purse to Spent, so placement and the last gold both matter.

weakest.why: Root Nymph grows by 1 a turn on thresholds that early turns can't reach; little to draft it for.
Lord Fennimore lowers numbers by 2 for one or two neighbours; a narrow enabler on a 4/3.
Signora Afide's 8 and 8 is hard to reach at Tier 4, so she is often a vanilla body.

flags.note: Mother Melissa with Old Messor at 16 gold gives every Hive unit +8/+8 a turn for free; golden Melissa triples it.
Ottavia with Granary Clerk interest and the Borrower's gold reaches about 8/8 to every unit a turn late; golden doubles to about 220 stats a turn.
Comptroller Gravelle fires ten 3-damage hits every fight from a 20-gold float that is never used up; golden is 60 damage before attacks.
Madame Cigale on a 20-30 gold drain turn gives every Carnival and Road unit +20/+20 or more at once; a planned spike, but large.
